name: Michael Scott
bio: Regional Manager of Dunder Mifflin Scranton. Thinks he's my best friend. Keep getting invited to 'Threat Level Midnight' screenings.

name: Chandler Bing
bio: Could he BE any later for lunch? Met through a mutual friend at Central Perk. Always makes jokes when he's uncomfortable.

name: Ron Swanson
bio: Doesn't believe in technology or communication. Only reached out once to ask where to buy high-quality land mines.

name: Jake Peralta
bio: Great detective, slash genius. Still owes me $20 for a pizza we shared in 2022. Title of his sex tape.

name: Phil Dunphy
bio: The 'cool dad.' Tried to teach me 'Phil's-osophy' while doing a magic trick. Always has a positive attitude.

name: Sheldon Cooper
bio: Bazinga! He has a strict roommate agreement and requires 72 hours notice before any social interaction.

name: Joey Tribbiani
bio: How you doin'? Only calls when he wants to know if I'm finished with my sandwich. Does not share food.

name: Barney Stinson
bio: It's going to be legen—wait for it—dary! He keeps trying to get me to play Laser Tag on a work night.

name: Cosmo Kramer
bio: Sliding into my apartment unannounced since 1989. Currently working on a coffee table book about coffee tables.

name: Dwight Schrute
bio: Assistant (to the) Regional Manager. He recently tried to sell me survivalist gear and beet-flavored energy drinks. Very intense.

name: Leslie Knope
bio: Sent me a 50-page itinerary for our next 'friendship brunch.' She is the most organized and caffeinated person I know.

name: Ted Lasso
bio: Brought 'biscuits with the boss' to my house. He doesn't understand offside rules in football, but he's a great listener.
